name: Steam Generator, Model F class (primary side only - secondary deferred)
notes: REBASED 2026-09-06 from US EPR to a late-1990s Westinghouse 4-loop PWR. The primary side is a straight lift - channel head, partition plate, inverted U-tube bundle and the SGTR states are identical in kind. Only the numbers and the deferred secondary-side plan changed. Originally US EPR FSAR Ch 5.4-derived; numerics approx. SCOPE decided 2026-07-10: primary side only (channel-head plena + tube bundle) so the reactor-SG-RCP-reactor loop is closed. The whole secondary side (shell, level/pressure, FW/EFW nozzles, MSSVs, MSRT, MSIV, blowdown, N16 monitor) is DEFERRED and will be added to this file later - modeled here only as the external:SG{n}-SEC heat sink. Tube bundle lives here (not loop.json) so the SGTR primary-to-secondary coupling stays in one file. Secondary relief for a W 4-loop is FIVE code safety valves per steam line plus one power-operated atmospheric relief valve, with MSIVs and their bypasses and steam dump to the condenser. The EPR arrangement this file originally planned (2 MSSVs per line + 1 MSRT with its own isolation valve) does not exist here - there is no MSRT. Also decide whether the chosen SG model has a feedwater preheater/economizer (Model D does, Model F does not) - the EPR axial economizer is not it. Revised 2026-09-06.

devices.name: SG {n} inlet plenum (hot channel head)
devices.behavior: Hot-side channel head: receives full loop flow from RCS{n}-HL and distributes it into the tube bundle. Divided from the outlet plenum by the partition plate. 'leak' = primary leak inside containment (e.g. manway) - casualty state.

devices.name: SG {n} U-tube bundle
devices.behavior: Inverted U-tube bundle, Model F class (6,633 tubes). Tube count is strongly plant- and model-specific: Model 51 has ~3,388, Model D5 ~4,578, Model F ~6,633, and replacement Delta-75/76 bundles differ again - pick the model when you pick the reference plant.  primary water flows up and back down inside the tubes, boiling secondary water on the shell side. THE primary/secondary boundary. 'leak' = small primary-to-secondary leakage (within tech-spec limits, slow secondary activity rise); 'rupture' = SGTR: one or more tubes severed, primary inventory blows into the secondary at full RCS-to-SG dP. Heat transfer scales with primary flow, primary-secondary dT, and tube condition. Secondary-side detection (N16, activity) arrives with the deferred secondary model.

devices.name: SG {n} outlet plenum (cold channel head)
devices.behavior: Cold-side channel head: collects tube-bundle discharge and delivers it to the crossover leg RCS{n}-XL toward RCP{n} suction.

secondary side boils off primary heat - DEFERRED, placeholder boundary until the secondary model lands in this file
SGTR leak path: active only in 'leak'/'rupture' states, primary water into the secondary shell
